report.description: Parameter-recovery truth (spec upgrade 3, section 4.1). Hand-made, not measured.
report.lifetime: S(t) = 0.3 * 1[t < 0.5 s] + 0.7 * exp(-t / 20 s) in every distance bucket, on a grid (50 ms to 5 s, 10 ms to 9 s, 50 ms to 20 s, 0.5 s to 100 s, 5 s to 400 s), then S = 0 at 600 s
report.placement: both sides alike: (1 + Delta)^-1.6 on Delta = 0..30; 10% of the mass on improving placements where the bucket allows them: none in bucket 1, Delta = -1 in bucket 2, uniform on -1..-4 in bucket 3+
report.rounding: every probability p is stored as the count floor(p * 10^9 + 0.5)
